My dearest Momo, I still remember holding you for the first time, so small that my hands trembled. Today I watched you walk across the stage, and my hands trembled again, this time with pride.

Every late night, every exam, every moment you doubted yourself and kept going anyway: I saw them all. You did this with your own strength and your own kind heart.

Wherever life takes you, remember that your Papa's door and heart are always open. I am so proud to be your father.
